source: Shape of a real VinCue Feed ID reply (support@dealercue.com, display "{name} from VINCUE Support Services", Oct 2026): "I have added the {dealership} to your export under the ID of {number}." — the dealership written in the reply's own capitalisation. Our request is support@'s HubSpot feed-request wording. Anonymized: dealer, people, domains, Feed ID value (format kept). Our side is shown as feeds@. VinCue's reply arrives on its own thread (not ours), so it is matched by the dealership named in the sentence before the ID.

messages.subject: Inventory Feed Request for: Harbor Hills Honda
messages.bodyHtml:
Hello VinCue Support and Rosa,

We’re requesting an inventory feed for:

Dealership: Harbor Hills Honda

Location: Bayport, CA

VinCue Support:

Please add Harbor Hills Honda to the Dealer Addendums inventory feed file and provide the store’s unique Dealer ID once completed.

Rosa:

Please Reply All to this email confirming that you approve this inventory feed request.

Once we have your approval and the Dealer ID from VinCue, we can complete the setup on our end.

Please let us know if you have any questions. Thank you!

Casey Lane
